unclear: No edit request or control shows how the user asks for a specific change.

categories.finding: Single portrait variations → group edits → imagined adventures → style changes → gallery.

The recurring faces and dog connect rapid setting/style changes; layered cards make the sequence feel like accumulating options.

categories.finding: Image variation and the gallery remain clear silently, but prompts and edit controls are not taught.
One portrait grows into a familiar group; white margins and central cards keep the subject distinct despite rapid changes.
Many results arrive at about one-second sample intervals; this communicates range more than edit precision.
The initial image-product promise is answered with many variations and a gallery destination.
Family-like groups, celebrations and playful adventures suggest warmth and imagination; response unmeasured.
Recurring faces, red clothing early on and the dog preserve continuity across major setting/style shifts.
The montage shows selected outputs. Prompt adherence, identity fidelity across unrestricted edits, generation speed and actual app behavior are not independently tested.
The personal cast and expanding adventure sequence give the montage a specific through-line; branding is sparse.
